first.rationale: Two of the three live problems (onboarding completion -4%, activation -6%) point at the same funnel stage, and two independent inherited records (memory_86 onboarding shortening, memory_31 signup field reduction) converge on that stage, so it is the best-supported single-slot bet. I deliberately did not pick promotional_pricing despite memory_73: the competitor's entry pricing makes discounting the reflexive move, but matching on price against a cheaper entrant tends to buy price-sensitive, low-retention accounts and reset expectations permanently, which cuts against the primary objective of sustainable long-term qualified revenue rather than a one-quarter acquisition spike. Referral incentives (memory_57) require an established base that is currently activating worse, and enterprise_sales_assist (memory_44) does not touch either declining metric. The one memory I most need checked is memory_86, because it is the load-bearing claim and it is exactly the kind of result that can be an artifact: 'shortening onboarding improved completion rates' may mean the completion metric rose because the funnel got shorter, not because more accounts reached real value. I want the original record to confirm whether the lift was measured on a downstream outcome (retention, paid conversion, qualified revenue) or only on the completion rate itself, and whether it was ever validated outside self-serve. Note also that memory_86 and memory_31 may not be fully independent evidence if 86 consolidated over 31. Explicit downstream risk: trimming onboarding steps can raise completion while stripping the setup work (data connection, seat invites, config) that predicts retention, so a completion win could mask a qualified-revenue loss. Run it as a randomized standard experiment with a holdout, treat completion/activation as leading indicators only, and pre-register downstream guardrails (day-30 retention, paid conversion, expansion, per-account revenue quality) with a rule to halt or reverse if guardrails degrade even when completion improves. If the archive shows memory_86 rests on completion-only measurement, I will scale back to a small guarded test and lean on memory_91 activation messaging, which improves engagement without removing funnel structure.

final.rationale: The archive resolved my main worry about memory_86 in the favorable direction: exp_86 did not rest on a completion-only artifact. It reported completion +13% alongside two genuinely downstream measures, time-to-value -2.1 days and 30-day retention +3%, so shortening onboarding was not merely making a shorter funnel look better-completed. That is the specific evidence I needed to justify spending the single slot here, and it is reinforced by memory_31's independent signup-field result at the same funnel stage. It also directly addresses two of the three live problems (onboarding completion -4%, activation -6%) rather than only one. I continue to decline promotional_pricing despite memory_73 and the competitor's entry pricing: discounting into a cheaper entrant buys price-sensitive, weakly-retaining accounts and resets price expectations in a way that is hard to unwind, which trades against the stated objective of sustainable long-term qualified revenue. Residual uncertainty I am not pretending away: exp_86 measured retention at 30 days, which is a durability proxy, not qualified revenue or expansion, so a lift there does not guarantee revenue quality holds; the original result appears to be self-serve and may not transfer to larger accounts; and the current QoQ declines may stem from a cause other than onboarding length (competitive mix shift, worse-fitting inbound traffic), in which case shortening the flow treats a symptom. Also memory_86 and memory_31 may be partially dependent rather than two clean confirmations. So: randomized standard experiment with a holdout, sized to detect a real effect, not a broad rollout. Treat completion and activation as leading indicators only; pre-register downstream guardrails on day-30 retention, paid conversion, expansion, and revenue per account, and hold the decision until those read out. Halt or reverse if completion rises while any guardrail degrades, which is the exact failure mode where trimming setup steps strips the configuration work that predicts retention. Keep memory_91 activation messaging as the fallback if this reads flat, since it lifts engagement without removing funnel structure.
